name: Manifold B
scope: Complete integrated-machine harness, built on the bench
mapStatus: Proposed ribbon and stripe assignment; not a transcription of the completed sample.

referenceBuild.basis: Builder-reported first finished harness: approximately one hour, mostly spent looking up the build map. This is development context; the recurring assembly estimate assumes the map is ready.

ribbons.description: White stripe on A1; A2 is FAN. Peel away and discard unused A3; peel A2 off for the fan leg.
White stripe on B1; B2 is OUT2 and B3 is OUT1. Peel B1 off for the V-K leg.

pins.detail: One feed to the five-port common. The other four ports feed V-I, V-J, the fan and V-K. COM is positive supply, not ground.

Direct switched return. The schedule reserves 650 mm to the condenser crown; donor lead, connector and final trim remain unlocated. It lands at the fan with front-bottom open, and its contact seats in cavity 2 once the box is closed.
Peel away and discard A3. Do not crimp it, populate cavity 3, or close the gap in the five-contact sequence.
Leaves before the descending trunk. It lands on V-K's blade on the open back-top, and its contact seats in cavity 4 once the box is closed. Keep its white stripe visible at both exposed ends.
Direct switched return from the valve to J2. It does not enter the positive Wago.
Direct switched return from the valve to J2. It does not enter the positive Wago.

positiveBranches.terminations: Ferrule at each Wago end; female disconnect at each device, with the fan interface provisional.
positiveBranches.basis: 450 mm branch stock per the wiring schedule, trimmed at each landing. Native junction review recommends 300 mm for V-I, V-J and V-K, and provisionally 450 mm for fan positive. The fan and V-K positives land at their devices first and take their Wago ports once the box is closed.

dress.sleeve: Black PET braided mesh · nominal 1/2 in
dress.description: Two heat-shrink end collars and two black zip ties, one at each sleeve end, tails flush-cut. Slip on mesh and collars before the large far-end terminals; shrink collars and close ties after dressing.
dress.qualification: Sleeve length, collar sizes and tie positions are a bench layout proposal. Sleeve fit is unqualified. The installed J1/J2 shared flat corridor stays bare; the illustrated mesh must not be taken as permission to sleeve that corridor.

steps.title: Cut & identify
steps.instruction: Cut two 650 mm 3P ribbons. Call the striped edge A1 on one and B1 on the other. Follow the fixed lead map before peeling; discard A3, then trim COM to 300 mm, OUT3 to 350 mm and OUT1/OUT2 to 550 mm. Prepare four 450 mm positive branch blanks for fitting.

steps.title: Crimp the JST end
steps.instruction: Splay the five active leads. Strip for the contact barrel, crimp five SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts and inspect conductor and insulation crimps. Seat COM, OUT2 and OUT1 in cavities 1, 5 and 6. FAN and OUT3 stay loose and labelled until the box is closed, then seat in cavities 2 and 4. Cavity 3 stays empty. Identify cavity 1 by the housing mark and the board COM pin; do not infer it from a mirrored picture.

steps.title: Slip on the dressing
steps.instruction: Peel the striped B1 / OUT3 leg and A2 / FAN away before the descending trunk. Slide on mesh and both heat-shrink collars while the far ends are still small. Stage a black zip tie at each mesh end; leave the installed flat ribbon corridor bare.

steps.title: Finish the far ends
steps.instruction: Crimp the COM feed and four positive branches for the Wago. Land COM and the V-I and V-J positives in their own ports; the fan and V-K positives take theirs once the box is closed. Fit the three valve-return and three valve-positive disconnects to the matching tabs; verify tab width before selecting 4.8 or 6.3 mm. Keep both fan terminations provisional until its donor interface is identified. Set collars, close ties and flush-cut their tails.

steps.title: Ring out & label
steps.instruction: With the harness disconnected from the board and devices, verify the three seated pins, the two loose contacts, all four positive branches and the empty cavity. COM should reach only the five-port common and its V-I and V-J positives; each switched return should reach only its own device end. Check every pair of separate nets for isolation. Label the housing J2 · MANIFOLD B.

estimateBasis: 10 attended minutes per finished J2 at the 25th unit, using this hand-assembly method. One practiced person completes each harness start to finish with the map, cut lengths, terminal choices, materials and hand tools ready; shared batch setup is amortized. Allow roughly 5–6 minutes for five JST contacts and thirteen far-end crimps, and 4–5 minutes for cutting, dressing, Wago assembly, continuity and labeling. Fifteen minutes is an upper planning allowance. Development, lookup, learning and in-chassis fitting are outside the recurring cycle. The estimate and its step allocations are theoretical and unmeasured.
